## v2.11.0 — 2026-05-04

Version 2.11.0 represents a major architectural shift with full open source conversion, removing all paid tiers and billing functionality while transitioning to an open core model with MIT licensing for core components and source-available licensing for the hosted platform.

### ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- Complete conversion to open source software with removal of all paid tiers and billing functionality
- Split codebase into separate OSS (cullit-oss) and platform-only repositories with updated package URLs

  • Split codebase into separate OSS repository (cullit-oss) and private platform-only repository with updated package URLs
  • Relicensed to open core model with MIT license for engine, CLI, and pro features, and source-available license for hosted platform

  • Added sponsor and star call-to-action elements across README, landing page, dashboard, and CLI interface to promote project visibility and support
  • Added GitHub Sponsors funding configuration to enable community sponsorship

  • Updated README to lead with platform-only notice and reflect new repository structure
